column1: # Which gate skills a changed file makes required. Read by .github/scripts/pr-rules.sh ("PR rules").
# Mirrors the file patterns in CLAUDE.md's Pre-Check-in and Pre-PR gate tables: when a row there
# changes, change its line here in the same PR.
# Format: <pattern><TAB><skill> [<skill> ...]. The pattern is a bash extended regex matched against
# each changed file's path. Docs (docs/, *.md) and .claude/ files never require a skill.
# Two rows are built into the script: a deleted code file requires coordinate-overlapping-pr-removals,
# and every code PR requires verification-loop.
# Rows no pattern can decide (state kept across launches, error handling, hex counts, …) are not here:
# the PR must still name them, as run or "Not applicable" with a reason.
